wait_for_discovery.title: Waiting for the Local OCR app

install_app_manual.title: Add the Local OCR app
install_app_manual.description:
Text Reader couldn't finish setting up the Local OCR app automatically.

1. If the Local OCR app isn't installed yet, [add the Local OCR app repository]({repo_link}) and install the app.
2. Start the Local OCR app.
3. Come back here and select Submit. Text Reader waits for the app to start.

local_container.title: Run Local OCR in a container
local_container.description:
This Home Assistant has no app store, so run Local OCR as a container on a 64-bit machine with 2 GB+ memory. Build the image as described in the [Local OCR docs]({docs_url}), then run:

```
{docker_run}
```

Then enter its address and the token you chose.

data_description.url: Where the Local OCR server listens, for example http://192.168.1.20:8738.
data_description.token: The LOCAL_OCR_TOKEN value the server was started with. Leave empty if it runs without one.

read_image.name: Read image
read_image.description: Reads the text in an image with the Local OCR app or an AI assistant and returns the result.

config_entry_id.name: Text Reader entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Text Reader entry to use. Optional when only one is set up.

image_entity.name: Image entity
image_entity.description: Read the current picture of this image entity.

camera_entity.name: Camera entity
camera_entity.description: Read a snapshot from this camera.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Read this file. Its folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: Read this item from a media source.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: What kind of text to expect. Defaults to the preset in the integration options.

backend.name: Backend
backend.description: Which reader to use: the Local OCR app, the AI assistant, or the app first with the AI as fallback. Defaults to the integration option.

region.name: Region
region.description: Only read this part of the image, as x, y, w and h. Values of 1 or less are fractions of the image width and height; larger values are pixels.

min_confidence.name: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Drop text recognised with less confidence than this (0 to 1). Defaults to the integration option.

all_frames.name: All frames
all_frames.description: For animated images, read every frame instead of just the first.
